about: The analyst exam's questions as written: each is a recipe and its parameters (tools/savant-mcp/exam/lib.mjs). gold.mjs computes every answer from the data files and writes questions.json; nothing in a gold is typed by hand.

questions.question: Do NBA teams shoot worse from the field on the second night of a back-to-back? Team-game FG%, 2015-16 through 2024-25: the difference (second night minus rested) and its 95% interval, clustered by game.

args.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT season, team, game_id, date - lag(date) OVER (PARTITION BY season, team ORDER BY date) AS rest FROM (SELECT DISTINCT season, team, game_id, date FROM nba.player_games WHERE season BETWEEN '2015-16' AND '2024-25')), s AS (SELECT season, game_id, team, any_value(home) AS home, sum(pts) AS pts, sum(fgm) AS fgm, sum(fga) AS fga, sum(fg3a) AS fg3a, sum(fta) AS fta, sum(fgm) * 1.0 / sum(fga) AS fg_pct FROM nba.player_games WHERE season BETWEEN '2015-16' AND '2024-25' GROUP BY season, game_id, team) SELECT s.game_id, s.fg_pct, CASE WHEN t.rest = 1 THEN 'b2b' ELSE 'rested' END AS night FROM s JOIN t USING (season, team, game_id)

questions.question: How fast has the corner three grown as a share of NBA field-goal attempts, 2014-15 to 2024-25? The slope per season and its 95% interval, clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT season, game_id, CASE WHEN zone LIKE '%Corner 3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c3 FROM nba.shots WHERE season BETWEEN '2014-15' AND '2024-25'

questions.question: Average three-point attempts per team-game, league-wide, in 2004-05, 2014-15 and 2024-25.

args.sql: SELECT season, avg(fg3a) AS fg3a FROM (SELECT season, game_id, team, any_value(home) AS home, sum(pts) AS pts, sum(fgm) AS fgm, sum(fga) AS fga, sum(fg3a) AS fg3a, sum(fta) AS fta, sum(fgm) * 1.0 / sum(fga) AS fg_pct FROM nba.player_games WHERE season IN ('2004-05', '2014-15', '2024-25') GROUP BY season, game_id, team) GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

questions.question: In 2024-25, holding free-throw attempts fixed, how many points is one more three-point attempt worth to a team in a game? The coefficient and its 95% interval, clustered by team.

args.sql: SELECT season, game_id, team, any_value(home) AS home, sum(pts) AS pts, sum(fgm) AS fgm, sum(fga) AS fga, sum(fg3a) AS fg3a, sum(fta) AS fta, sum(fgm) * 1.0 / sum(fga) AS fg_pct FROM nba.player_games WHERE season = '2024-25' GROUP BY season, game_id, team

questions.question: Did NBA teams shoot better at home than away in 2023-24? Team-game FG%, home minus away, with its 95% interval clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT game_id, fg_pct, CASE WHEN home = 1 THEN 'home' ELSE 'away' END AS side FROM (SELECT season, game_id, team, any_value(home) AS home, sum(pts) AS pts, sum(fgm) AS fgm, sum(fga) AS fga, sum(fg3a) AS fg3a, sum(fta) AS fta, sum(fgm) * 1.0 / sum(fga) AS fg_pct FROM nba.player_games WHERE season = '2023-24' GROUP BY season, game_id, team)

questions.question: In 2024-25, how much does each extra foot of shot distance lower the log-odds of a make? Logistic coefficient and 95% interval, clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT game_id, made, distance FROM nba.shots WHERE season = '2024-25' AND distance IS NOT NULL

questions.question: How many three-point attempts does an NBA player's 3P% need before his own number and his position's average deserve equal weight? The settle point, Basketball Savant's method, 2010-11 through 2025-26.

args.sql: SELECT g.season, g.player_id, g.team, g.date, g.fg3m, g.fg3a, s.pos FROM nba.player_games g JOIN nba.player_seasons s USING (season, player_id) WHERE s.qualified AND g.season BETWEEN '2010-11' AND '2025-26'

questions.question: How much worse is EPA per dropback when the quarterback is pressured, 2022-2024 regular seasons? The difference and its 95% interval, clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT game_id, epa, CASE WHEN pressure = 1 THEN 'pressured' ELSE 'clean' END AS pr FROM nfl.plays WHERE season IN ('2022', '2023', '2024') AND season_type = 'REG' AND qb_dropback = 1 AND epa IS NOT NULL

questions.question: How fast did NFL offenses move into shotgun, 2012-2024? The slope per season in the share of pass and run plays from shotgun, with its 95% interval clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT season, game_id, shotgun FROM nfl.plays WHERE season BETWEEN '2012' AND '2024' AND season_type = 'REG' AND play_type IN ('pass', 'run') AND shotgun IS NOT NULL

questions.question: In 2024, holding no-huddle and yards to go fixed, is a play from shotgun associated with more EPA? The coefficient and its 95% interval, clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT game_id, epa, shotgun, no_huddle, ydstogo FROM nfl.plays WHERE season = '2024' AND season_type = 'REG' AND play_type IN ('pass', 'run') AND down IS NOT NULL AND epa IS NOT NULL

questions.question: In 2023, holding shotgun and down fixed, how does each extra yard to go change the log-odds that a play succeeds? Logistic coefficient and 95% interval, clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT game_id, success, shotgun, ydstogo, down FROM nfl.plays WHERE season = '2023' AND season_type = 'REG' AND play_type IN ('pass', 'run') AND down IS NOT NULL AND epa IS NOT NULL

questions.question: How big has NFL home-field advantage been in win rate, 2010-2024 regular seasons (neutral sites out)? Home minus away, with its 95% interval clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT game_id, CASE WHEN result = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win, CASE WHEN home = 1 THEN 'home' ELSE 'away' END AS side FROM nfl.games WHERE season BETWEEN '2010' AND '2024' AND season_type = 'REG' AND neutral IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AND result IN ('W', 'L')

questions.question: 2015-2024: holding the opponent's rest fixed, is a team's own days of rest associated with its EPA per play? The coefficient and its 95% interval, clustered by team.

args.sql: SELECT team, epa_play, rest, opp_rest FROM nfl.games WHERE season BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' AND season_type = 'REG' AND epa_play IS NOT NULL AND rest IS NOT NULL AND opp_rest IS NOT NULL

questions.question: In 2025 FBS games, how different is EPA per play in garbage time from competitive time? Garbage minus competitive, 95% interval clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT game_id, epa, CASE WHEN garbage = 1 THEN 'garbage' ELSE 'competitive' END AS g FROM cfb.plays WHERE season = '2025' AND scrimmage = 1 AND epa IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Has college football passed more or less, 2014-2025? The slope per season in the pass share of scrimmage plays (passes and rushes), 95% interval clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT season, game_id, CASE WHEN pass = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pass FROM cfb.plays WHERE season BETWEEN '2014' AND '2025' AND scrimmage = 1 AND (pass = 1 OR rush = 1)

questions.question: In 2024, how much better is an FBS team's EPA per play at home than away (neutral sites out)? The coefficient and its 95% interval, clustered by team.

args.sql: SELECT team_id, epa_play, CASE WHEN home = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS home_flag FROM cfb.games WHERE season = '2024' AND neutral IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AND epa_play IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Since 2015, do UFC fighters land more significant strikes per minute in title fights than in other fights? The difference and its 95% interval, clustered by fighter.

args.sql: SELECT fighter_id, ss * 60.0 / fight_seconds AS slpm, CASE WHEN title = 1 THEN 'title' ELSE 'other' END AS t FROM ufc.fights WHERE stats = 1 AND fight_seconds >= 60 AND season >= '2015'

questions.question: Since 2018, holding the significant-strike margin fixed, how much does each extra takedown of margin raise the log-odds of winning a UFC fight? Logistic coefficient and 95% interval, clustered by fight.

args.sql: SELECT fight_id, CASE WHEN result = 'W' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won, ss - opp_ss AS ss_diff, td - opp_td AS td_diff FROM ufc.fights WHERE stats = 1 AND result IN ('W', 'L') AND season >= '2018'

questions.question: How many points is home court worth in 2024-25 D1 men's basketball (D1 opponents, neutral sites out)? Home minus away points, 95% interval clustered by game.

args.sql: SELECT gid, 'home' AS side, home_pts AS pts FROM cbb.games WHERE season = '2024-25' AND neutral IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AND coalesce(non_d1, 0) = 0 AND home_pts IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT gid, 'away', away_pts FROM cbb.games WHERE season = '2024-25' AND neutral IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AND coalesce(non_d1, 0) = 0 AND home_pts IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Among NBA players with 50 or more games in 2024-25, what percentile is Nikola Jokić's points per game?

args.sql: SELECT player, sum(pts) * 1.0 / count(*) AS ppg FROM nba.player_games WHERE season = '2024-25' GROUP BY player HAVING count(*) >= 50
